BACKGROUND & EDUCATION

I build across domains, with engineering rigor as the constant.

I’m a software and AI engineer and Computer Science M.S. candidate at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County. My work spans enterprise integrations, full-stack product development, clinical interoperability, medical imaging, scientific NLP, computer vision, knowledge graphs, and research-driven machine learning.

I’m strongest where disciplines meet: translating an ambiguous problem into a structured data model, a reliable API, a measurable model workflow, and a product people can actually use. Whether the domain is pediatric oncology, climate science, disaster response, or business operations, I bring the same approach—understand the data, design the system carefully, validate failure paths, document decisions, and build for maintainability.

I’m targeting AI/ML engineering, data science, data engineering, and software engineering roles where I can contribute across experimentation, architecture, and implementation while continuing to deepen my work in responsible, high-impact technology.
